description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es aumentar la productividad agrcola en Suriname mediante inversiones en infraestructura y gestin de sistemas de I D y mejorando la calidad de las estadsticas agrcolas disponibles.

The project's objective is to increase agricultural productivity in Suriname through investments in infrastructure and management of Irrigation and Drainage (ID) systems and by improving the quality and availability of agriculture statistics.
